description: Operational notes carry the tag yt2b first. Publishable yt2b-blog notes are the exception: their tags field contains public topic taxonomy only, while type, yt2b_status, yt2b_rights and yt2b_mode provide operational filtering. Facet tags are optional and written as <namespace>/<value>, for example stage/briefed or rights/own.

stage.description: Where a run or note sits in the pipeline; mirrors the queue and run statuses.

format.description: What kind of artifact a note is.

intake.description: Discovery state before an item becomes a governed pipeline queue note.

source.description: Origin channel for discovery and pipeline artifacts.

rights.description: Who holds the rights to the source video; drives voice, frame caps, hero policy and attribution.
